Remark
[Local Lipschitz characterization; failure for $1\le p<\infty $] ↗ thm:characterization-w1infty-lipschitz ↗ thm:sobolev-embedding-w1p-supercritical 1. ch5:5.8-rem-4\group Difference Quotients

For every open $U$, $u\in W^{1,\infty }_{\mathrm{loc}}(U)$ if and only if $u$ is locally Lipschitz. No analogous equivalence holds for finite $p$: if $n<p<\infty $, then $W^{1,p}\subset C^{0,1-n/p}$, but Holder continuity with exponent less than one does not imply membership in any $W^{1,p}$.
